channel.title: North Wales Chronicle - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Chronicle (northwaleschronicle.co.uk)

item.title: Missing North Wales pregnant woman found 'safe and well', police say
item.description: A search is underway for a missing pregnant woman from Llandudno, with police saying they have "increasing concerns" for her safety.

item.title: Livestock stolen from field on Anglesey as police appeal for information
item.description: Police are appealing for information after livestock was stolen from a field on Anglesey.

item.title: Man arrested on suspicion of theft from motor vehicles in Caernarfon
item.description: A man has been arrested on suspicion of theft from motor vehicles after being seen trying to open car doors in an area of Caernarfon.

item.title: Holyhead in the frame with North Wales 2040 Olympic Game
item.description: Wrexham’s STōK Cae Ras has been highlighted as a potential football venue, while sailing events could be staged in Holyhead.

item.title: Five new ‘lifetime homes’ completed as families prepare to move in on Anglesey
item.description: Three Cyngor Sir Ynys Môn councillors visited the site, which was formerly home to the British School, built in 1848 by Lord Stanley of Alderley.

item.title: 'Absolute delight' - Michael Sheen spotted across North Wales on his stage tour
item.description: Michael Sheen was spotted across North Wales during his Our Town run.

item.title: Senior officer and ex-councillor attempted to pocket £3,000 Beaumaris Pier fee
item.description: A former Gwynedd councillor and senior Anglesey Council officer has been banned from holding office for three years after admitting attempting to defraud his employer by asking a film company to pay him £3,000 for hiring Beaumaris Pier.

item.title: Corwen estate Lord continues disposal of Gwynedd land with whole lot up for £10m
item.description: It is the first time in more than three centuries that the estate has been made available. In all, the 901 acres has a guide price of £10.9m!

item.title: Beaumaris told ‘no’ as Anglesey Council blocks transfer of cash‑generating car park
item.description: Beaumaris Town Council has failed in its bid to secure an asset transfer of the Castle Car and Coach Park, which brings in more than £100,000 a year.

item.title: Detective brands North Wales killer a ‘coward’ after unanimous murder verdict
item.description: Devenport, formerly of Prestatyn, was found guilty of murder at Chester Crown Court on Wednesday with a jury delivering a unanimous verdict.
